text:
amelia: Heads-up — Saffron Systems dedicated switchover proposed for Wed 2026-03-25 02:00-04:00 UTC. Requesting approval and final rollout plan.

dave: Ack. Can we keep a 30m canary before full traffic? Want pin to runtime v2.7.1 and the new quant config.

sara: 02:00 window works for customer. They asked for KMS rotation after migration. Ops OK?

mike: Oncall will be me that night. I want explicit rollback thresholds and an automated drain if latency > 300ms p50 for 5m.

amelia: Proposed rollout steps:
1) deploy control plane changes (pin model=redwood/saffron-v1 @ v2.7.1)
2) 30m canary at 5% of traffic (slice A)
3) observe metrics and perf checks (latency, token cost, error rate)
4) progressive rollout to 100% over 60m if green
5) KMS rotation and final validation

amelia: Rollback plan: immediate rollback to previous runtime v2.6.9 if any of:
- error rate > 1% sustained for 5m
- p95 latency increase > 50% over baseline for 5m
- token cost delta > 25% without quality improvement

dave: LGTM on thresholds. Add a manual hold at 35% to confirm eval prompt set.

amelia: added manual hold at 35%.

mike: Please add a circuit-breaker to fallback to small-model tier (redwood/compact-v1) if GPU pool unresponsive.

sara: Noted — customer signed off on maintenance window and KMS rotation timing (after canary passes).

deploy-bot: [deploy request received] user=amelia repo=inference-control plan_file=rollout_saffron_185432.json

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z window=2h target=dedicated-saffron-pool runtime=v2.7.1

deploy-bot: canary configuration: slices=[A:5%], hold_at=35% manual=true canary_duration=30m

oncall-bot: @mike oncall rota confirmed for 2026-03-25 01:30-05:00 UTC. Pager thresholds set to high for deploy window.

mike: I'll be in the channel during the window. Please post release notes and the eval checklist before deploy.

amelia: Release notes draft (short):
- Runtime v2.7.1: improved KV cache handling, quantization profile 3 for saffron models, bugfix for attention mem leak.
- Pinning: saffron-v1 -> runtime v2.7.1.
- Known risk: slight token cost increase on long sequences (mitigated by cache warm-up).

amelia: Eval checklist (quick):
- smoke: simple generation prompt set (10 prompts) -> pass rate >= 95%
- perf: p50 < 180ms, p95 < 400ms on canary slice
- quality: top-1 BLEU on eval set within delta 0.02 of baseline

dave: Add config snippet for pin: ```json
{"model_pin": "redwood/saffron-v1@v2.7.1", "quant": "profile3", "autoscale": false}
```

sara: Ops note: we'll run a config diff and snapshot metrics at T-15m. Also taking customer DB read-rep snapshot pre-cutover.

deploy-bot: preflight checks: infra_quota=ok, kms_keys=present, model_artifact=available, canary_policy=valid

deploy-bot: preflight PASS.

mike: One more ask — document exact rollback command and the expected time to restore (SLO).

amelia: Rollback command (single-line): ```redwoodctl rollout rollback --target dedicated-saffron-pool --to-runtime v2.6.9 --force``` Estimated restore time: 6-12 minutes to drain and revert slices.

dave: Approving from engineering side :thumbsup:. I'll be live for the canary hold.

sara: Approving from customer ops.

mike: Approving oncall. I'll escalate if p95>500ms or errors spike.

amelia: Great — final go/no-go checklist: approvals from engineering, customer ops, oncall -> all present. Scheduling deploy.

deploy-bot: rollout queued. notifier=@saffron-contacts email=ops@saffron.example.com

deploy-bot: ETA start 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z. Will post updates in-thread during rollout.

amelia: Thanks team — I'll post the canary metrics and eval results in this thread during the window. :rocket:

mike: I'll watch logs and traces. If anyone needs me ping @mike.

(deploy-bot later in thread during rollout would post step updates — those will be new messages in a follow-up thread)
